title: 第15章 交易灵能徽章第16章 异瞳少女心灵控制
slug: 全民高塔开局一个神话天赋
lines: “请大家放心，巡查局会保护每一个联邦公民！”
柳争揉了揉肩膀，开口道：“但我还有一些事情要做，希望大家安心等待。”
“迷雾快来了，红坊村不在迷雾的笼罩范围内......”
来到近前，吴语便听到柳争侃侃而谈。
打开【地图】，他看了一眼倒计时。
“确实是快了。”
和客栈伙计打听消息的时候，吴语就问过迷雾相关的事了，但伙计一问三不知，表示这地方偶有晨雾，但有危险的迷雾却是不存在的。
最近天气晴朗，也没见过什么晨雾出现。
因此，
吴语认定“迷雾”很可能只会对登塔的人有影响！
至于是毒素，怪物还是腐蚀性气体，都只能靠猜测了。
忽地，他听到了什么声音。
当即抬头看去，却见一架微型无人机在一栋栋屋子上飞过，无人机底部有什么东西在转动。
“那架可以发射灵能炮弹的无人机！”
“这东西我在黑鸦商会上都没见过。”
“看样子......是在摄录视频？”
吴语若有所思。
柳争毕竟是官方人员，应当是在收集此地的情报。
这时，
柳争看到了吴语，朗声道：“小哥也来了！”
“柳巡查。”
吴语礼貌回应。
柳争微微颔首，询问道：“请问一下，小哥是否见过那位金老板？”
“金老板？”
吴语心头一动，立刻明白对方说的是谁了。
回忆了一下，吴语回答道：“分散后没见过，但逃跑的时候我看到他往荒原那边跑了。”
“慌不择路啊！”
柳争眉头紧皱，知道金老板危险了。
“柳巡查，我有些话要和你说。”
吴语缓缓开口。
柳争审视了吴语一眼，颔首道：“看你的样子也是住了一晚的，上楼一叙？”
content_en:
"Please rest assured that the Inspectorate will protect every federal citizen!"
Liu Zheng rubbed his shoulders and said, "But I still have some things to do. I hope everyone can wait with peace of mind."
"The fog is coming, and Hongfang Village is not within the scope of the fog..."
...
When Wu Yu came closer, he heard Liu Zheng talking eloquently.
Opening the [Map], he glanced at the countdown.
"It's really fast."
When inquiring about the information from the innkeeper, Wu Yu asked about fog-related matters, but the waiter didn't know anything about it. He said that there was occasional morning fog in this place, but there was no dangerous fog.
The weather has been sunny recently and I haven't seen any morning fog.
Therefore,
Wu Yu determined that the "fog" would probably only affect those who climb the tower!
As for whether it is toxins, monsters or corrosive gases, we can only rely on guessing.
"Buzz-"
Suddenly, he heard something.
He immediately looked up and saw a micro-drone flying over the houses, and something was spinning at the bottom of the drone.
"That drone that fires psychic cannonballs!"
"I've never seen this thing before at the Black Crow Chamber of Commerce."
"It looks like... you're recording a video?"
Wu Yu was thoughtful.
After all, Liu Zheng is an official and should be collecting intelligence here.
At this time,
Liu Zheng saw Wu Yu and said loudly: "Brother is here too!"
"Inspection Liu."
Wu Yu responded politely.
Liu Zheng nodded slightly and asked, "Excuse me, have you met that boss Jin?"
"Boss Jin?"
Wu Yu's heart moved, and he immediately understood who the other party was talking about.
After recalling it, Wu Yu replied: "I haven't seen him since we were separated, but when I was escaping, I saw him running towards the wasteland."
"You are so panicked that you don't have to choose the right path!"
Liu Zheng frowned, knowing that Boss Jin was in danger.
"Inspector Liu, I have something to tell you."
Wu Yu spoke slowly.
"Oh?"
Liu Zheng took a look at Wu Yu, nodded and said, "It looks like you've stayed here for one night. Why don't you go upstairs to talk?"
"Please!"
